changes.new: Door-to-door sales of $25 or more made away from the seller's place of business, whether at the specific invitation of the buyer or not, on top of the federal rule
changes.support: Yes, on the official text: "whether at the specific invitation of the buyer or not" (NRS 598.180).

changes.new: Three business days (598.230); statement beside the signature (598.240) and duplicate form (598.250); oral notice (598.280)
changes.support: NRS 598.250 sets out the full NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form (below). Bold type is required; no point size is given.

changes.new: Sunday and ten named holidays (including Martin Luther King, Jr.'s Birthday and Nevada Day) are not business days; Saturday counts; refund within 10 business days. Do not use the small cancellation penalty in NRS 598.260; the federal rule allows none.
changes.support: NRS 598.150: Sunday and ten named holidays are excluded, including Martin Luther King, Jr.'s Birthday and Nevada Day. Saturday counts. Refund wording in the form is "within 10 business days".

changes.new: Written contract for work on an owner-occupied single-family residence (NRS 624.970, AB 39); pool and spa contracts over $1,000 (NRS 624.940)
changes.support: any contract entered into between a residential contractor and the owner of a single-family residence who occupies the single-family residence for work concerning a residential improvement

changes.new: State license. Work to repair or maintain property worth under $1,000 (labor and materials) is exempt unless it needs a building permit, is plumbing, electrical, refrigeration, heating or air-conditioning work, significantly affects health, safety and welfare, is part of a larger project of $500 or more, or is done by a licensee. Pool and spa work for a fee needs a license with no dollar floor (NRS 624.920); whether the $1,000 exemption reaches small pool repairs is not settled
changes.support: NRS 624.920 bars any pool or spa work for a fee without a license and has no dollar floor.

changes.new: NRS 40.645 pre-suit notice by certified mail; contractor's written response within 90 days (NRS 40.6472); inspection and chance to repair (NRS 40.647); covers remodels (NRS 40.615)
changes.support: contractor's written response "not later than 90 days after the contractor receives the notice" (40.6472(1)(a))

unsure: NV-fund: the statement is required of a residential contractor in any agreement for qualified services; whether that means every residential contract or only owner-occupied single-family ones is not settled, and the block is held anyway.

NV-info-liens and NV-info-contractors: duty falls on a general building contractor with the owner of a single-family residence; the builder cannot tell single-family or owner-occupied, so the text is stored on file only.
NV-owner-notice, NV-pool-rights, NV-pool-notice: the statutes require a notice but prescribe no wording, so nothing is loaded.
NV-pool-notice and NV-pool-rights: added from the pool sections; unclear whether the owner wants them on the checklist for every pool contract.

NV-cancel-form: the oral notice (NRS 598.280) has no wording and is not loaded; the form is meant to be handed over completed by the seller (NRS 598.250 'fully completed form'), so its blanks stay as printed.
